stories.title: Brewers rally vs. Rays to take 2-0 lead in World Series
stories.summary: The Brewers rallied from a 4-0 deficit in the first inning to beat the Rays 5-4 in Game 2 on Saturday and take a 2-0 lead in the World Series.

stories.title: Texas, Arch hold off Ole Miss rally to snap 2-game skid, cool criticism
stories.summary: No. 19 Texas pulled out a wild victory over No. 7 Ole Miss after blowing a 21-point lead in the second half Saturday night.

stories.title: 76ers' Brown claims no beef, but says Tatum has 'hell of a PR team'
stories.summary: In the latest turn in the relationship between former teammates, Jaylen Brown said Jayson Tatum should "stay ready at all times" while denying the two have beef.

stories.title: Jokic rips booing fans after rallying Nuggets: 'They're not welcome anymore'
stories.summary: Nikola Jokic racked up his 199th career triple-double, dropping 35 points, 15 rebounds and 10 assists as the Nuggets rallied from 23 down to beat the Pelicans.

stories.title: BYU's Sitake disputes roughing the kicker call in 2OT, but UCF 'bested us'
stories.summary: BYU coach Kalani Sitake disagreed with a roughing the kicker penalty that led to UCF's eventual winning score, but he refused to call the loss a letdown.
